title: core.command.v1 UnlockWallet payload
description: Clears the PIN lockout of a wallet (status LOCKED after 5 wrong PINs, spec 9.1): status back to ACTIVE, failure count 0. Sent by mw-admin-api once an ops-checker approved an ops-maker's unlock request (maker-checker, ticket 52). The core answers WalletUnlocked, or UnlockRejected (reasonCode WALLET_NOT_FOUND, WALLET_NOT_LOCKED). Carries no PIN.

subject.description: The wallet to unlock: its id (the MSISDN for app wallets).

makerId.description: Operator username who asked for the unlock.
